ZFS entries that only replicate now say they are waiting for their replica, and their page no longer lists storage locations they do not back up to.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **A ZFS entry set to Replica only, no backup said Waiting for the first backup,** in the backups list, on its own page and on the overview, although no backup of it will ever come. Until its replica has run once it now says **Waiting for the first replica**, and after that it counts as protected. ([#359](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/bombvault/discussions/359))
- **The page of such an entry listed the section's own folder under Storage locations** with 0 backups, although that folder is switched off for it. The card now shows the replica and only those storage locations that still hold older backups of the entry. ([#359](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/bombvault/discussions/359))
